choices.why: It is the only true light grey three-seater, and at 234 cm it suits the long left wall while its clean modern lines fit the bright white room.
At 200x300 cm it is the largest rug, so it can anchor the whole seating zone from sofa to TV stand, and its grey-beige wave pattern ties into the grey wood-look floor.
It is the only light wood option, and its Scandinavian shape keeps the space airy and luminous as requested.
The low off-white console blends into the white walls to keep the room bright, and its 174 cm length balances the sofa across the room.
The arc lamp can stand in the corner and reach over the sofa with a warm drum shade, and its black finish echoes the black balcony door frame.
The terracotta cushions add the color the user asked for against the light grey sofa, and their neutral tassels tie back to the rug.
The tall, leafy areca palm brings lush green beside the balcony door and enjoys the bright light there.
The white sheer pair softens the wide sliding door while letting the light through, as the user wanted.

answer.why: A light grey sofa, light ash table, white console and sheer curtains keep the living room bright and modern. The large grey-beige rug anchors the seating zone, the black arc lamp echoes the window frame, and the terracotta cushions and palm add warm and green accents for receiving friends.
